brief: Create a small funny story of a cat becoming president of the US.

coverage.observation: Inspected an orange tabby with triangular ears, whiskers, vertical pupils, paws and tail; the sleeping pose retains its species, palette and facial features.
The cat raises its paw behind a campaign podium with its name and nap platform; US flags and audience silhouettes provide a rally setting.
The results bar grows to a 99 percent victory for Mittens over a drawn vacuum cleaner; the cat raises both paws under confetti.
The office contains US flags, a presidential desk/nameplate and an executive-order paper; the cat stamps the order and later sleeps on the desk.
Visible gags are a vacuum losing the election and the cat immediately obeying its mandatory-nap order. These setups/payoffs are readable in frames; audience humor response is not measured.

declared_review.notes: Implementation-model review of actual overview/contact-sheet images and selected action frames. Sampled-frame review only; normal-speed playback and audio listening were not assessed. This is an authored regression demonstration, not an independent other-LLM transfer result. Inspected the paw extension/contact/retraction sequence at frames 336 through 402; the arm is deliberately stylized and stretches. After the stroke-visibility diagnostic fix, every regenerated preview PNG was hash-identical to the previously inspected output; the same observations apply to this current preview.

preflight.meaning: Checks geometry visibility and authored coverage only. A reviewer must verify identity, actions, story and comedy in the actual pixels.

limitations: Sampled-frame review only; normal-speed motion and sound remain unassessed.
